focus: Public open-source technology hunting for trading research, verified revenue, RETALLY social media, falsifiable novel discovery, engineering-time reduction and existing ABVM, PermitPlate, CaptureBrief and Portfolio Brain projects. No Genesis or retired StarBlox dedicated hunters.
rules: Search public repositories only for lawful rights-reviewable material. Discovery outputs are untrusted leads, not code execution or guaranteed outcomes.
Require explicit project assignment and direct applicability to active work; no dedicated Genesis or retired StarBlox research.
Keep exact revision, licensing, attribution, source provenance, security limitations, test evidence and remaining acceptance gates; never present a discovered repository as a deployed improvement.
Trading research is observational/simulated only: no brokerage orders, secrets, paid services, live positions or fabricated backtest performance.
Scientific novelty is UNKNOWN unless a reproducible finding survives independent experiments and serious human/AI literature/prior-art review; GitHub search alone cannot establish novelty.
Engineering-time savings are UNKNOWN until measured against a real before/after task on an active repository with working integration and independently verified behavior.
Social media research does not authorize posting, messaging, engagement automation, bypassing platform limits or scraping private content.
No live publishing, merging, spending, customer outreach, child/medical records, credentials, leaked/confidential material, or unsafe access techniques.
Unlicensed code is reference-only without proven rights. Private target code must never be copied or exposed in public scout output.

workers.mission: Trading research: find independently testable data-ingestion, walk-forward backtesting and market microstructure tools; identify reproducible research edges after costs and out-of-sample checks, never execute trades or claim profits from simulations.
workers.evidence_gate: Verify fresh market-data provenance, realistic transaction costs, out-of-sample results and independent reproducibility; no orders or unverified alpha claims.

workers.mission: Revenue hunt: find reusable B2B prospect discovery, customer conversion, billing/reconciliation and measured funnel tools that could help active RETALLY businesses achieve a first independently verified collected dollar.
workers.evidence_gate: Success requires independently verified customer action or actual collected payment; a lead, mock purchase, generated invoice or GitHub candidate is not revenue.

workers.mission: RETALLY social media: research rights-compliant campaign planning, content QA, platform APIs, audience conversion attribution and credible metrics; no unsolicited posting, scraping, account access or automated engagement.
workers.evidence_gate: Verify lawful platform support, owner-controlled approval, attributable real engagement or inbound leads, and actual conversion; publishing requires separate authorization.

workers.mission: High-risk original discovery research: search open scientific datasets, falsifiable hypothesis-generation and symbolic-discovery techniques; propose testable candidate findings and aggressively check prior literature and existing AI work before any novelty claim.
workers.evidence_gate: Unprecedented discovery is UNKNOWN unless reproducible independent evidence and substantive human/AI prior-art review support it; never promise that a new discovery exists.

workers.mission: Engineering time reduction: find technically inspectable GitHub code, codemods, test selection, reproducible builds and debugging automation applicable across active projects; target substantial measured reductions in engineering hours, not novelty scores.
workers.evidence_gate: Require exact source revision, license verification, measured baseline-versus-after engineer time, passing target-specific checks and working integration before recording time saved.
